clips.title: The story
paras: The Temple of Zin-Malor is an ancient night elven sanctuary located within the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara. Originally dedicated to the moon goddess Elune, the crumbling structure is now held by the Spitelash naga under the direct command of Warlord Krellian.

Before the Great Sundering, the Temple of Zin-Malor stood as a grand house of worship dedicated to Elune. Its architecture closely mirrors both the nearby Temple of Arkkoran and the modern Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, bearing the graceful, sweeping stonework characteristic of pre-Sundering night elven civilization. Today, however, its moonlit marble is weathered and broken, overtaken by the serpent-bodied Spitelash naga. These invaders have claimed the holy grounds for themselves, turning a place of quiet reflection into a militarized redoubt.
The temple once housed the renowned Crystal of Zin-Malor, a potent artifact that was carried away long ago to Kel'Theril in Winterspring.
